flow.name: account-export-process
flow.doc:description: Incrementally upserts changed Salesforce Accounts into the configured XLSX workbook.

set-variable.value: #[do { var incoming = attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default correlationId --- if ((incoming as String) matches /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$/) incoming else correlationId }]

logger.message: #[write({correlationId: vars.exportCorrelationId, applicationName: 'salesforce-account-excel-export', environment: p('app.environment') default 'local', flowName: 'account-export-process', source: 'manual-api', status: 'started'}, 'application/json')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import effectiveWatermark from dwl::AccountWorkbook output application/java --- effectiveWatermark(vars.existingWorkbook, vars.storedWatermark)
%dw 2.0 import effectiveWatermark, buildAccountQuery from dwl::AccountWorkbook output text/plain --- buildAccountQuery(effectiveWatermark(vars.existingWorkbook, vars.storedWatermark))

set-variable.value: #[if (vars.salesforceAccounts is Array) sizeOf(vars.salesforceAccounts) else dw::Runtime::fail('Salesforce query did not return an Account array')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import mergeAccounts from dwl::AccountWorkbook output application/java --- mergeAccounts(vars.existingWorkbook, vars.salesforceAccounts)
%dw 2.0 import nextWatermark from dwl::AccountWorkbook output application/java --- nextWatermark(vars.salesforceAccounts, vars.watermark)

logger.message: #[write({correlationId: vars.exportCorrelationId, applicationName: 'salesforce-account-excel-export', environment: p('app.environment') default 'local', flowName: 'account-export-process', source: 'manual-api', status: 'completed', mode: if (vars.watermark == null) 'initial' else 'incremental', recordsExported: vars.recordCount, recordsInserted: vars.mergeResult.inserted, recordsUpdated: vars.mergeResult.updated, totalRows: sizeOf(vars.mergeResult.rows), fileName: vars.exportFileName, durationMs: (now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) - vars.startedAtMillis}, 'application/json')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "completed", mode: if (vars.watermark == null) "initial" else "incremental", recordsExported: vars.recordCount, recordsInserted: vars.mergeResult.inserted, recordsUpdated: vars.mergeResult.updated, totalRows: sizeOf(vars.mergeResult.rows), fileName: vars.exportFileName, correlationId: vars.exportCorrelationId }

logger.message: #[write({correlationId: vars.exportCorrelationId default correlationId, applicationName: 'salesforce-account-excel-export', environment: p('app.environment') default 'local', flowName: 'account-export-process', source: 'manual-api', status: 'failed', errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier, durationMs: (now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) - (vars.startedAtMillis default (now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}))}, 'application/json')]

set-payload.value: #[{error: 'EXPORT_FAILED', message: 'The Account export could not be completed.', correlationId: vars.exportCorrelationId default correlationId}]
